name: isaiah48vs17-gmgn-cli-dep
description: Not a Node app - this file exists only so `npm install` (run by nixpacks.toml during the Railway build) has a package.json to write gmgn-cli into, at a path src/data/gmgn.py resolves directly (node_modules/.bin/gmgn-cli). See src/data/gmgn.py's module docstring for why a global npm install doesn't work here.
